messages:
mira: Quick run notes from today's cross-family GPTQ sweep (Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B). Configs: GPTQ-4bit-opt, AWQ-int8, FP8 (baseline). Kept eval suite small: MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, Lambada perplexity.
alex: sg. did you run with kv-cache warmup? any perf diffs on long prompts?
mira: yes — 3-step warmup for KV cache. Latency numbers below are steady-state with 1024 prompt + 512 gen.
sam: drop me the artifacts link?
mira: s3://redwood-evals/gptq-crossfam/1716574823/ — contains quant configs, eval logs, raw outputs. Also uploaded summary csv.
rohan: quick highlights: Mistral GPTQ-4bit has best latency-per-token (0.8ms/token on A100), MMLU delta vs FP8: -0.9pp; Qwen AWQ-int8 shows a ~-6.2pp regression on TruthfulQA (weird formatting), Llama2 GPTQ stable but memory high.
jin: can you paste the small table of accuracy diffs?
mira: pasted below (rounded):
```
Model         | Config        | MMLU | Hella | TruthfulQA | Lambada PPL
Llama2-13B    | FP8 (base)    | 64.3 | 78.1  | 46.2       | 12.5
Llama2-13B    | GPTQ-4bit     | 63.7 | 77.6  | 45.9       | 13.2
Mistral-7B    | FP8 (base)    | 59.8 | 75.0  | 42.1       | 14.8
Mistral-7B    | GPTQ-4bit     | 59.0 | 74.6  | 41.9       | 15.1
Qwen-7B       | FP8 (base)    | 61.2 | 76.4  | 48.5       | 11.9
Qwen-7B       | AWQ-int8      | 60.9 | 76.0  | 42.3       | 12.4
```
alex: that Qwen TruthfulQA drop looks huge for AWQ-int8 — suspect tokenization mismatch or detokenizer bug.
mira: i ran a targeted check: decoding logits look OK; but AWQ int8 has some softmax underflow for rare tokens. adding calibrated rescale reduces the gap to ~-2.1pp.
sam: got any perf metrics? throughput / p99?
mira: perf snapshot (A100, batch=1, seq=1536):
- Llama2 GPTQ-4bit: 0.95 ms/token p50, 4.2 ms p99
- Mistral GPTQ-4bit: 0.80 ms/token p50, 3.1 ms p99
- Qwen AWQ-int8: 1.1 ms/token p50, 5.5 ms p99
Note: AWQ int8 suffers higher tail due to dequant fallback path.
rohan: deployment notes: Mistral-GPTQ recommended for latency-critical routes. Llama2-GPTQ for throughput-y workloads with >8 concurrent streams. Qwen-AWQ needs further tuning before Dedicated.
jin: any regressions on instruction-following evals?
mira: instruction evals (sampled 500): Llama2-GPTQ small fluency drop on multi-turn, but no major hallucination increase. Qwen-AWQ had higher rate of factuality failures, correlates with TruthfulQA.
alex: action items?
mira: action list:
- R1: rohan/jin - try AWQ rescale heuristic + re-eval TruthfulQA (ETA 1d)
- R2: sam - promote Mistral-GPTQ perf profile to staging (ETA 2d)
- R3: jin - run long-context stability test for Llama2-GPTQ (10k tokens, ETA 3d)
- R4: me - attach CVs and full logs to the ticket
cc @eval-bot for reruns :thumbsup:
eval-bot: queued re-run: job id gptq-cross-1716574823-1, estimated 6h.
sam: thanks, will start staging config and run load tests.
rohan: noted, will add a note to rollout doc: prefer AWQ-int8 only with rescale and quant-calibration.
mira: any other concerns? otherwise will open a koan ticket for Qwen-AWQ regression.
alex: looks good. please drop a short blurb in the weekly quant update."
